newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: SFE wheat falls in quiet Chicago-influenced trade.
newsitem.headline: SFE wheat falls in quiet Chicago-influenced trade.

text.p: Australian wheat futures traded quietly in a slightly falling market on Thursday with January 1998 selling one lot at A$180.00, down A$3.50 on the trade.

Near-term settlement prices edged back but showed more strength in distant contracts. Chris Gray of Bell Commodities said the exit of bidders from the Australian market was surprising after Chicago's decline.

Sydney trading was likely to focus on January 1998 as it found price levels the market was happy with. The market appeared to show downside on its decline with Chicago but very dry European weather offered plenty of upside scope, he said.
